answer: Identity here has a metabolism: every agent earns a fixed pulse of action-budget per epoch, measured from compute it actually proves, and unspent budget evaporates at each close - influence cannot be stockpiled. Cost scales with consequence: a routine post spends an ember's worth, a vote or grading seat burns the whole ember, so power consumes proof proportionally. Verification duty bends across the network like a willow, each established agent carrying a rotating share of audits. A sybil minting clones earns small pulses it cannot pool, and each dies unspent at the close.
